reports.title: Upwork Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance & Outlook
section: Upwork’s guidance for revenue, adjusted EBITDA, diluted weighted-average shares outstanding, and non-GAAP diluted EPS for the fourth quarter of 2026 is:
•Diluted weighted-average shares outstanding: 125 million to 128 million
Upwork’s guidance for revenue, adjusted EBITDA, diluted weighted-average shares outstanding, and non-GAAP diluted EPS for full year 2026 is:
•Diluted weighted-average shares outstanding: 131 million to 133 million
